title: REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP fails with REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP_ONLY_TRANSFERABLE
pattern: A transaction whose REVOKE_SPONSORSHIP operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (only_transferable). A claimable balance always has a sponsor: revoking it outside a sponsorship sandwich, with no new sponsor, is refused.

hazards.placement: claimable-balance sponsorship revoked without a new sponsor

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
